title: The Gift She Never Expected
content:
For the next few minutes...

Shreya told Sneha everything.

She spoke about meeting Siddu after five long years.

She told her how much he had changed.

How success had transformed him into a confident and respected businessman...

Yet how his kindness had remained exactly the same.

She also shared everything they had spoken about that evening.

Sneha listened without interrupting.

Every word eased the burden she had been carrying in her heart for years.

Finally, before ending the call, Shreya smiled softly.

"Sneha..."

"Don't worry."

"Siddu is perfectly alright."

"He's doing well."

"And..."

"He still isn't as happy as he pretends to be."

Sneha closed her eyes.

A wave of relief washed over her.

"Thank you, Shreya."

"Thank you so much..."

"I can never repay this favor."

Shreya chuckled gently.

"If you really want to thank me..."

"Then make sure your love story gets its happy ending."

Sneha smiled through her tears.

"I'll try."

"Take care."

"You too."

The call finally ended.

________________________________________

Sneha slowly walked back into the living room.

Her mother was sitting quietly, waiting for her.

The moment she saw Sneha, she stood up.

"Sneha..."

"I'm sorry."

"I never understood what was hidden inside your heart."

Before Sneha could reply, her mother wrapped her in a warm hug.

Sneha hugged her back tightly.

For a few silent moments...

Neither of them spoke.

Sometimes...

A hug could heal what words never could.

Just then...

Sneha's phone rang once again.

She looked at the screen.

Boss Calling...

She immediately answered.

"Hello, sir?"

"Sneha, I need you at the office immediately."

"We have something important to discuss."

Before she could ask anything...

The call ended.

Sneha looked at the phone in confusion.

"What could be so urgent?"

She quickly got ready and left for the office along with Yagnesh.

________________________________________

The moment Sneha entered the office...

Everyone turned toward her.

"Congratulations, Sneha!"

"Happy Birthday!"

She stopped in surprise.

Confused, she looked around.

Smiles filled every face.

Not understanding what was happening, she walked straight toward her boss's cabin.

Her boss stood up with a broad smile.

"First of all..."

"Happy Birthday, Sneha."

"And congratulations."

Sneha smiled politely.

"Thank you, sir."

"But..."

"Why is everyone congratulating me?"

Her boss picked up a file from his desk.

"Because you achieved something that no one in this company has managed before."

He placed the file in front of her.

"One of France's most prestigious companies..."

"The company led by the Indian entrepreneur Siddhartha..."

"Has officially agreed to form a partnership with us."

Sneha's heart skipped a beat at the mention of Siddu's name.

Her boss continued,

"Do you know how significant this is?"

"Normally, companies from all over the world approach them, hoping to secure a partnership."

"But this time..."

"They were the ones who approached us."

He smiled proudly.

"They were particularly impressed by the quality of your work and specifically requested that you lead this collaboration."

"This opportunity became possible because of your dedication and hard work."

Sneha stood speechless.

She had never imagined that her efforts would lead to something this extraordinary.

Her boss smiled once more.

"And that's not all."

He handed her another document.

"Starting next week..."

"You'll be representing our company in France."

"This is your promotion."

For a few seconds...

Sneha simply stared at the letter in her hands.

France...

The country she had spent the last five years trying to reach.

The place where Siddu lived.

The distance that once felt impossible...

Had suddenly disappeared.

A smile slowly spread across her face.

Her eyes shimmered with tears of happiness.

Just then...

Her phone vibrated softly.

She glanced at the screen.

A new message had arrived.

The sender's name made her heart stop.

Siddu.

With trembling fingers, she opened the message.

It read...

"How is my birthday gift?"

Sneha froze.

She looked at the words again.

Then at the promotion letter in her hand.

A gentle smile spread across her face.

"So..."

"This was your gift..."

A single tear rolled down her cheek.

Not out of sadness...

But because, after five long years...

Siddu had remembered her birthday.

And without saying "Happy Birthday"...

He had given her the one gift she had wished for the most.

A path that finally led her to him.

For the first time in five long years...

Hope no longer felt like a distant dream.

It had finally become reality.
